Technical Description: Price breaks above a previous swing high or below a previous swing low.
Human-Readable Rules and Definitions: The starting point or 'signal fire' of a trend. Often referred to as the 'explosion' or 'cap flying off', providing evidence that price can move further in a specific direction.
Trading Action/Decision: Do not trade the indication directly; use it as a blueprint to identify potential entry and exit points.

Technical Description: A pause or reversal move following an indication, often involving a liquidity grab from breakout traders.
Human-Readable Rules and Definitions: A trap designed to shake out emotional FOMO traders. It represents the 'mess' or 'cleaning up the fizz' after the initial explosion, revealing the market's true intent.
Trading Action/Decision: Wait for the correction to finish; monitor on lower timeframes to observe when the 'mess' has been cleaned up.

Technical Description: Price flips the trend back toward the original indication direction after the correction phase concludes.
Human-Readable Rules and Definitions: The confirmed sustainable move. This occurs once the market has harvested enough liquidity to fuel the trend in the direction of the original indication.
Trading Action/Decision: Enter the trade when price moves back beyond the indication level and structure aligns on lower timeframes.

Technical Description: Pivot points where price reaches a peak or trough and rejects in the opposite direction.
Human-Readable Rules and Definitions: These act as 'clues' or 'bricks' representing levels where buyers (lows) or sellers (highs) are positioned. Usually, only the previous 1–3 sessions are marked.
Trading Action/Decision: Use these levels to define 'No Trade Zones' and to identify the initial indication.

Technical Description: The process of aligning higher timeframe (HTF) trends with lower timeframe (LTF) entries.
Human-Readable Rules and Definitions: The HTF (1H/4H) provides the 'satellite view' for the big picture, while the LTF (15m/5m) acts as the 'microscope' for precision. All timeframes must align before execution.
Trading Action/Decision: Mark structure levels on 1H/4H; execute and monitor trade entries on 15m/5m.

Technical Description: Price dipping into pools of stop-losses to collect capital required for the primary trend move.
Human-Readable Rules and Definitions: The market 'needs to grab cash' to move. It targets the stop-losses of early breakout traders and late FOMO traders to fuel the real move.
Trading Action/Decision: Anticipate a reversal or deep pullback once a new high/low is made to avoid becoming part of the liquidity.

Technical Description: Price remains between established swing highs and swing lows without a valid indication.
Human-Readable Rules and Definitions: A zone with no clear direction. Trading here is risky/illogical as the market is just building pressure (the 'shaking the Coke bottle' phase).
Trading Action/Decision: Do not place trades while price is in this zone; wait for a definitive breakout (indication).
